summary: Answer strict current Email header questions locally when the selected run contains exactly one analyzed Email.
decision_refs: The active objective requires efficiency and accuracy improvements across Email as well as RFI and Submittal content
The local Email parser already separates current headers from body, quoted history and signatures
The complete cached workflow index can establish whether an otherwise-unspecified Email question has one unambiguous target
approval_evidence: The persistent objective authorizes bounded efficiency and accuracy improvements to the existing file-grounded question flow.
known_limitations: Only strict English Subject, sender, recipient and Date forms use the local shortcut.
The shortcut applies only when the complete selected run contains exactly one analyzed Email; multi-Email questions must name a file or exact workflow context and use ordinary grounded retrieval.
Only explicit current EMAIL > HEADERS evidence qualifies; body, quoted history, signatures, mailbox state and transport metadata do not.
More than 32 current-header passages fails closed, and the shortcut does not infer delivery time, thread position, identity, authority or semantic equivalence.
